subject: Instats & ASA Launch Free Research Training for U.S. Government Employees

messages.author: 4a9ea0beae24eb02
messages.subject: Instats & ASA Launch Free Research Training for U.S. Government Employees
parts:
Hi everyone

Today, Instats (instats.org) is proud to announce a new initiative in partnership with the American Statistical Association (ASA) to empower U.S. public servants. Starting immediately, all government employees with a .gov email address can freely access our premier streaming library of expert-led research training content—the entire library of over 200 courses (including for lavaan), with thousands of hours of content streaming in 4K, free of charge. This includes all federal, state, and local government employees with a .gov email address.

Our comprehensive library covers a range of topics from statistics and data science to advanced quantitative and qualitative research methods, designed to support the analytical skills essential for evidence-based decision making in government. By democratizing access to high-quality training, we’re investing in the continuous professional development of those who serve our communities.

Eligible government professionals can sign up at instats.org using their official .gov email to unlock this resource. Join us in advancing public service and shaping a future where informed decisions lead to lasting impact.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
Institute for Statistical and Data Science
